recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical split-screen composition featuring a high-contrast silhouette of a male figure against a purple and blue twilight sky on the left, and a solid black panel with vibrant neon-pink script and minimalist white sans-serif text on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic gradient of the sky and the flat black void of the sidebar.
Juxtaposition of expressive, fluid handwriting against rigid, spaced-out block lettering.
Visual weight balance between the large silhouette and the right-aligned text block.
coreInvariants: Vertical division of the frame approximately at the 60/40 ratio.
Silhouette must be underexposed to show minimal detail, emphasizing the profile.
Sky must transition from a warm lavender-pink at the horizon to a deep indigo at the top.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male figure in profile, waist-up, occupying the left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright pink script in the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the silhouette's profile, moves right to the pink script, then descends down the right column through the spaced text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy use of black negative space on the right to provide breathing room for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and black for mood and depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Lavender and soft pink in the sky gradient.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta-pink for the primary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the silhouette and sky; high saturation contrast between the black background and neon text.

letterConstructionRules: Primary text: Rapid, gestural brush strokes with varying thickness and rounded terminals.
Secondary text: Monolinear, wide-set, all-caps geometric characters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders in script should be tall and slightly slanted to the right.
Secondary text uses extreme letter-spacing (tracking) to create a vertical column effect.

composition.relationshipToImage: aligned to the right edge of the black panel

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive organic script paired with rigid, spaced-out geometric sans-serif for a modern-classic contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the 90s gestural energy of the primary text.
Provides the clean, geometric skeleton needed for the spaced secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vertical split image. The left 60% is a photograph of a man in profile silhouette against a purple and blue dusk sky. The right 40% is a solid matte black panel.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add magenta-colored handwritten script in the top right corner. Below it, add white all-caps geometric sans-serif text, right-aligned with extreme letter spacing and one word per line.

verificationChecks: Is the silhouette sharp and dark against the sky?
Is the sky gradient smooth from lavender to indigo?
Is the magenta text fluid and handwritten in style?
Is the white text spaced out vertically on the right?

adjustableVariables: Amount of letter spacing in the secondary text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or album titles
Specific graphic logos on the clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the split between the photo and the black panel is a clean vertical line.
Check that the magenta script looks like natural ink/marker.
Verify the white text is perfectly right-aligned.
Confirm the silhouette has no internal facial features visible.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dusk-lit silhouette with a high-contrast black sidebar for a dramatic, 90s-inspired editorial layout.
